response.sql: WITH f AS (SELECT zoneref, traitcount, CAST(traitcount AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(traitcount) FROM scanfeatures WHERE traitcount IS NOT NULL) AS share FROM scanfeatures WHERE traitcount IS NOT NULL), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM f) SELECT f.zoneref AS site_code, f.traitcount AS feature_count, f.share AS share, f.share - a.avg_share AS margin_above_average FROM f CROSS JOIN a WHERE f.share > a.avg_share ORDER BY margin_above_average DESC LIMIT 10
